references.text: Tappuah is mentioned as a city in the inheritance of the tribe of Judah and refers to the same city that was conquered from the king of the Canaanites.
Tappuah is mentioned again in connection with the border between Manasseh and Ephraim, referring to the same geographical area.
Heber is mentioned as one of the descendants of Manasseh, and the Heber clan may have given its name to the city and region ruled by the king of Heber.
Heber is mentioned as a district under Solomon's rule, referring to the same area that was conquered from the king of Heber.
